newsitem.title: GREECE: Natl Mortgage cleared for bonus shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Natl Mortgage cleared for bonus shr issue.

text.p: National Mortgage Bank got shareholder approval for a bonus share distribution in its repeat shareholders' meeting on Wednesday.
The bank will issue a total of 1,944,000 bonus shares with shareholders entitled to one bonus share for every five outstanding.

The bonus share distribution is the result of a capitalisation of reserves -- 673 million drachmas -- and gains from the revaluation of its fixed assets -- 2.63 billion -- as per law 2065/92, it said. The bonus shares will have a par value of 1,700 drachmas.

National Mortgage Bank president Vassilis Rapanos told shareholders he was optimistic on the bank's prospects this year following last year's jump in profitability. The bank's profits rose to 36.08 billion drachmas in 1996 from 20 billion a year earlier.
He said first quarter results were up 10 percent year-on-year.
